title: What --cpus limits
statement: On a host with 8 CPU cores, you run `docker run --cpus=1.5 myapp`. What does this do?
choices: Pins the container to cores 0 and 1
Reserves 1.5 cores so no other process can use them
Sets the container's relative CPU weight to 1.5 times the default, used only when CPUs are contended
Caps the container's total CPU time at 1.5 cores' worth per scheduling period, spread over any cores
